name: Claude-BugHunter
description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 84 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
one_liner: A pack of pre-built know-how you install into Claude Code so it hunts for security bugs in websites and apps like an experienced professional, instead of you teaching it from scratch every time.
buyer: A freelance bug-bounty hunter or a 2-3 person boutique pentest shop who bills clients for security assessments but doesn't have a bench of senior researchers.
business_use_cases: A freelance bug hunter uses it to triage a new HackerOne target overnight and only spends their own hours validating the top 3 findings instead of doing full recon by hand.
A boutique pentest firm standardizes the skill bundle across junior analysts so every client report follows the same severity/VRT format a senior would write.
A security consultancy offers a flat-fee 'pre-launch bug bounty readiness scan' for startups, using the bundle to produce a first-pass report before a human reviews it.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'done-with-AI' bug-bounty triage service: client gets a ranked, reviewed vulnerability report in 48 hours
Offer a managed/updated version of the skill bundle plus onboarding support to small security teams

steal_this: This weekend, install the bundle, run it against 2-3 public bug bounty programs you're already eligible for, and ship a priced 'AI-assisted triage report' service page before Monday.
